[SWS_PER_00523]
⌈
ara::per::ReadAccessor::ReadText shall read the n
characters of text from the current position and return them as an ara::core::-
String. The position shall be incremented by n. In case the end of the file is
reached during this operation, the available characters shall be returned, and the posi-
tion shall be set to the end of the file.
⌋
